subject: Orion Health – vendor onboarding: remit/W-9/ACH + PO process

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dev.patel@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Orion Health – vendor onboarding: remit/W-9/ACH + PO process

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Orion Health fully onboarded. To complete vendor setup and enable PO/invoicing, can you please provide the following items? If some are in process please flag what’s pending and an ETA.

Required for finance:
- Completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) – PDF preferred
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on vendor record (including DBA if applicable)
- Tax ID / EIN (formatted as XX-XXXXXXX)
- Remit-to mailing address (for any mailed checks)
- Bank details for ACH: bank name, routing number, account number (we accept last 4 digits masked in email)
- Wire instructions (bank name, ABA/Swift, beneficiary name/address) if you prefer wire payments

Additional onboarding items:
- Filled vendor intake form (I attached our onboarding spreadsheet for convenience)
- Primary account owner and billing contact (name/email)
- Any PO prefix you expect us to use on PO numbers (helps auto-match invoices)

A couple notes on Redwood’s PO/payment policy:
- Standard terms: Net 30 from invoice date unless otherwise negotiated
- PO requirement: PO is required for invoices > $5,000; please include PO number on invoice PDF
- We prefer ACH; wires are possible but require correspondent details and will incur bank fees

If helpful I can loop in Dev in Finance for the bank details verification. Please attach your W-9 and bank form as PDFs and reply here.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Samir — received the attachments and started the verification. A couple follow-ups to complete the ACH setup: 

1) For security we only store masked account numbers in email threads. On the bank form I see full account numbers — could you confirm the last four digits here for quick cross-check? (we will upload the full form into our secure vendor portal).

2) Please confirm the ACH routing number is for domestic ACH (9 digits). If you operate multiple accounts, confirm which bank/account is for accounts receivable to Redwood.

3) For wire: provide beneficiary SWIFT + intermediary bank if international. If you want wires as primary method, flag that and we'll note it on the vendor record (we may require an operations escalation for recurring wires).

4) PO workflow: Laura — can you confirm: for Orion, we should require PO for any invoice > $5k (standard), and set the PO prefix to ORH- so the invoice parser matches?

I'll hold off final activation until the routing/account confirmation and the signed W-9 are securely uploaded to our portal.

—Dev
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference
